title: The scalar normal averages μ(B_ρ(x))⁻¹ ∫_{B_ρ(x)} ⟨ν, ν_E(x)⟩ dμ tend to 1 at a reduced-boundary point (Simon (1); parent Steps 2, 3 and 5)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N open, μ a measure on ℝ^N with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and ν : ℝ^N → ℝ^N μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ν| = 1 μ-a.e. Let x ∈ reducedBoundary U μ ν and e := reducedNormal μ ν x. Then μ(B_ρ(x)).toReal⁻¹ · ∫_{B_ρ(x)} ⟨ν(y), e⟩ dμ(y) → 1 as ρ ↓ 0 (along 𝓝[>] 0), with the Lean convention 0⁻¹ = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable ν μ → (∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ‖ν y‖ = 1) → ∀ x ∈ reducedBoundary U μ ν, Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (μ (Metric.ball x ρ)).toReal⁻¹ * ∫ y in Metric.ball x ρ, inner ℝ (ν y) (reducedNormal μ ν x) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)
